 ❯ Write a 300-word paragraph about lighthouses. Do not use any tools.                                           17:20 ┃

 ● Lighthouses stand as some of humanity's most enduring symbols of guidance, safety, and perseverance. Built on rocky █
   headlands, remote islands, and treacherous shoals, these towers have warned sailors of danger for thousands of      █
   years. The ancient Pharos of Alexandria, constructed in the third century BCE, set the template: a tall structure   █
   topped with a fire whose glow could be seen far out at sea. Over the centuries, builders refined the design,        █
   learning to craft towers that could withstand relentless waves, howling winds, and crushing storms. John Smeaton's  █
   Eddystone Lighthouse, completed in 1759, introduced interlocking granite blocks inspired by the shape of an oak     █
   tree, a technique that influenced engineers for generations. The light itself evolved just as dramatically. Open    █
   flames gave way to oil lamps, then to the revolutionary Fresnel lens, invented in the 1820s, which concentrated     █
   light into a powerful beam using concentric rings of glass prisms. A single lamp could suddenly be seen for twenty  █
   miles or more. Keepers lived in these isolated outposts, trimming wicks, polishing brass, winding clockwork         █
   mechanisms, and logging weather through long nights. Their work was lonely and demanding, yet it saved countless    █
   lives. Today, automation, GPS navigation, and electronic charts have made most keepers unnecessary, and many        █
   lighthouses have been converted into museums, inns, or protected landmarks. Still, they remain active aids to       █
   navigation in many places, flashing distinctive patterns that let mariners identify their position. Beyond their    █
   practical purpose, lighthouses capture the imagination. Painters, poets, and photographers return to them again and █
   again, drawn by their stark silhouettes against stormy skies and their quiet promise that safe harbor is near.      █
   Communities fight to preserve them, volunteers restore their weathered stones, and visitors climb their spiral      █
   stairs to gaze across the endless horizon. In a world of constant change, the lighthouse endures as a reminder that █
   steady light, faithfully tended, can help anyone find their way home through the dark.                              █
